analysis.themes: A history professor meets his exact double and his life unspools — the double reads as the self he represses, and the spiders as the web of his own compulsions.
analysis.atmosphere: Jaundiced, hazy unease; Toronto looks air-sick, and the film keeps you unsure whether you're watching events or a mind.
analysis.narrative: A puzzle box that resists solution — is the double real, a split self, a metaphor? The final image answers nothing and everything.
analysis.visual: Nicolas Bolduc's yellow-washed, smog-drowned photography turns a real city into a fever state.
analysis.characters: Adam and Anthony are one psyche in two bodies — timid conformity and appetite — which is why only one can survive.
